financeRoleDecision.decision: NO dedicated finance-specific PostgreSQL roles (union_eyes_finance_runtime / union_eyes_finance_system) created this round.
financeRoleDecision.rationale: Every financial-service-owned relation is currently classified LATENT_UNREACHABLE with zero required runtime/system privileges — there is no current privilege-separation problem to solve, since financial-service itself has no live deployment path at all.
financeRoleDecision.requiredFollowUp: If/when financial-service is actually deployed, this decision MUST be revisited against its then-real, evidenced privilege requirements before that deployment ships — re-open every entry in db/rls-storage-authority/financial-service-latent.ts at that time.

arbitrationDecisionsDefect.after: writeRole: 'content_manager' (ROLE_HIERARCHY level 208, a genuine PLATFORM_ELEVATED_ROLES member) on all 5 routes. Verified no ordinary tenant role (member 20, steward 50, chief_steward 90, admin 140) can exceed level 208.

blanketGrantRemoval.generatorSelfCheck: generate-rls-enforcement-migration.ts computes blanketGrantRemovalGateOk = (blockers.length === 0 && every manifest entry has non-TBD privileges) fresh on every run — a future un-classified table addition automatically re-widens back to the safe blanket-grant-retained state.
blanketGrantRemoval.action: PART E added to the migration: REVOKE SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public + REVOKE USAGE, SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public FROM union_eyes_runtime, union_eyes_system. Schema USAGE and database CONNECT grants retained (baseline connection-level access, not per-table data access).
blanketGrantRemoval.sequenceAudit: 0 PostgreSQL sequences exist anywhere in the canonical schema (every table uses a UUID default, not serial/bigserial) — the sequence REVOKE requires no replacement grant.
blanketGrantRemoval.noEquivalentWildcardGrant: Verified via grep: 0108 contains no GRANT ... TO PUBLIC and no role-membership grants beyond the removed table/sequence grants plus the retained schema USAGE / database CONNECT.
